title: Polish chatbot and AI workspace UX
body:
## Summary
- Improve floating chatbot responsive layout, streaming/stop states, and retryable error feedback
- Polish the full-page AI workspace with desktop chat framing, mobile Chats drawer, and accessible conversation row actions
- Update docs and add changesets/tests

## Verification
- pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot type-check
- pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot test -- src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.test.tsx src/__tests__/tool-display.test.ts src/__tests__/FloatingChatbot.test.tsx
- pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check
- pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test -- src/console/ai/__tests__/ConversationsSidebar.test.tsx src/layout/__tests__/ConsoleChatbotFab.test.tsx
- In-app browser verification for floating chat and /ai/:conversationId desktop/mobile layouts
